environment.description: Same Node.js Apollo server deployed on EC2 in private subnet (no IGW route). Exposed exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint service. The VPC endpoint policy attached to the consumer-side vpce restricts Principal to arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/IotDeviceProxyRole and limits actions to execute-api:Invoke. The provider-side NLB target group health check validates /graphql?query={health} returns 200. Endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' enabled, meaning only manually-approved AWS accounts can create endpoint connections. The private subnet's route table has no 0.0.0.0/0 route (no NAT, no IGW). Security group on the EC2 instance allows inbound only from the VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16) on port 4000. Additionally, the VPC has no VPC peering connections and no Transit Gateway attachments.

config.deployment: EC2 t3.medium, us-east-1a, private subnet (no IGW/NAT route)
config.network: SG ingress 10.0.0.0/16:4000 only, no public IP assigned
